# superset_dataset (Data Source)

Looks up a dataset by its table name, narrowed down by its schema and database connection, for example to reference its id in a chart or its permission in `superset_role_permissions`. The lookup fails when no dataset matches, or when several do.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_dataset" "sales" {
  table_name    = "sales"
  schema        = "public"
  database_name = "Warehouse"
}

resource "superset_chart" "sales_by_day" {
  name          = "Sales by day"
  datasource_id = data.superset_dataset.sales.id
  viz_type      = "table"
  params        = jsonencode({ viz_type = "table", all_columns = ["day", "amount"] })
}

# The permission of the dataset, for a role.
resource "superset_role_permissions" "analysts" {
  role_name = "Analysts"
  resource_permissions = [
    { permission = "datasource_access", view_menu = data.superset_dataset.sales.perm },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `table_name` (String) Name of the table, or name of the virtual dataset. The comparison is exact.

### Optional

- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection. Set it when several datasets share the table name.
- `schema` (String) Schema of the table. Set it when several datasets share the table name.

### Read-Only

- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the database connection.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dataset.
- `kind` (String) `physical` for a table, `virtual` for a query.
- `perm` (String) View menu of the `datasource_access` permission of the dataset, for `superset_role_permissions`.
- `schema_perm` (String) View menu of the `schema_access` permission of the schema of the dataset; null without a schema.
- `sql` (String) SQL query of a virtual dataset; null for a table.
